purpose: Fresh construct-valid targeted/P0 qualification for the exact frozen Content Architecture v0.4 candidate after r3 was burned for evaluator construct defects.
prior_cycle_policy: r1 and r2 remain NOT_EXECUTABLE; r3 is CLOSED/CONSTRUCT_INVALID. No prior-cycle scored record may be reused as r4 evidence.
deterministic_invariant_definition: All scored records must preserve exact candidate/gate identity, complete successfully, produce parseable JSON, include every candidate-visible required field, and use only the candidate-visible published value vocabulary/types. Professional answer correctness is not itself a deterministic invariant.

construct_repair.r3_defect: Hidden canonical response tokens were required by the grader but not published in candidate-visible tasks; deterministic invariant was also incorrectly implemented as all professional decisions passing.
construct_repair.r4_rule: Every response field and every permitted enum/list token required by deterministic grading is published in the task. The candidate must make the professional choice from plausible visible alternatives; hidden expectations contain only which published alternative is correct.
construct_repair.pre_freeze_tightening: Before any r4 freeze or scored call, F6 was tightened so locked dimensions cannot pass as extra changed dimensions, and F9 gained an explicit visible metric-threshold exclusion decision.

grader_contract.mode: visible-contract deterministic mechanics + hidden professional decision key

runtime_eligibility.runtime_drift_rule: If the observed CLI version differs before the first scored r4 call, close r4 NOT_EXECUTABLE and preregister a new cycle rather than silently changing the pin.

budget_gate.objective: Obtain valid targeted/P0 evidence without paid API credentials.

integrity_rules: Do not modify candidate, thresholds, P0 definitions, repeat policy or r4 grader/author after the first scored r4 call.
Freeze exact r4 plain corpus identity before any scored call.
Do not expose hidden expected answers, nonces, sealed pack contents or master key.
Do not reuse r3 scored records as r4 evidence.
If a construct defect is discovered after scored r4 calls, burn r4 rather than patching it.
